building.title: 58 Symonds Street (435), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 435's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 435 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 2.99 m over the provisional ground (50.65 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the tower's long faces (bearing 313.6 deg), so z faces south-west (bearing 223.6 deg). The ground falls from about 56 m on the north-west side to 38 to 47 m on the south-east
